templates.title: Improve overall attendance
templates.defaultMeasure: on at least 90% of scheduled sessions
measureOptions: on at least 90% of scheduled sessions
on at least 95% of scheduled sessions
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action} {measure}. This will be checked using {evidence} and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to discuss barriers affecting attendance, agree practical support and review progress weekly.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Review the learner's attendance record for the agreed period and record whether the target has been achieved, partially achieved or not achieved.

templates.issue: Repeated absence on a particular day
templates.title: Patterned absence (particular day)
measureOptions: on at least 90% of scheduled Fridays
no unauthorised absence on that day
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action}. If an unavoidable barrier prevents attendance, you will contact your tutor or Success Coach before your first scheduled lesson. Attendance will be checked using the register and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to discuss barriers affecting attendance for the specific day and agree appropriate support.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Check attendance registers for the agreed days and record outcomes.

templates.title: Recent decline in attendance
templates.defaultAction: attend the agreed sessions and make up any missed work
templates.defaultMeasure: attend at least 90% of scheduled sessions in the review period
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action} {measure}. This will be checked using {evidence} and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to agree steps to improve attendance and record any support offered.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Document whether attendance has improved and next steps.

templates.title: Improve first-lesson punctuality
templates.defaultAction: arrive before the scheduled start of your first lesson
measureOptions: on at least 90% of college days
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action} {measure}. Punctuality will be checked using the register and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to discuss reasons for lateness and identify practical solutions.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Review punctuality and record whether the learner has improved or requires further support.

templates.title: Repeated lateness across the timetable
templates.defaultAction: arrive before the scheduled start of each lesson
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action} {measure}. This will be checked using {evidence} and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to agree adjustments and check travel or timetable barriers.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Review punctuality for the agreed period.

templates.title: Increase verbal participation
templates.defaultAction: contribute verbally at least once in each session by answering a question or sharing an idea
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action}. This will be monitored through {evidence} and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to encourage participation and provide safe prompts during lessons.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Record examples of participation and any ongoing barriers.

templates.title: Reduce off-task behaviour
templates.defaultAction: focus on the set task and use a planner to record actions
measureOptions: on task for majority of session
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action}. Progress will be reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to discuss strategies to improve focus and set short-term tasks.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Note frequency of off-task behaviour and agree next steps.

templates.title: Complete and submit outstanding assignment
templates.defaultAction: complete and submit the outstanding assignment (Unit or task placeholder)
templates.targetTemplate: By {reviewDate}, you will {action}. You will attend the agreed support session and show a draft to your lecturer before submission. Completion will be checked through {evidence} and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to arrange a support session and check the draft before submission.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Confirm submission date and whether the assignment meets the required standard.

templates.title: Improve timeliness of submissions
templates.defaultAction: submit the outstanding work by the agreed deadline
templates.targetTemplate: By {reviewDate}, you will {action}. This will be checked using {evidence} and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to agree a realistic deadline and offer additional support where needed.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Record whether work was submitted on time and any support provided.

templates.title: Ensure required equipment is brought to lessons
templates.defaultAction: bring the required equipment to each lesson
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action}. This will be checked by {evidence} and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to remind the learner and agree practical steps (e.g. checklist or locker).
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Record whether equipment is consistently brought to lessons.

templates.title: Reduce disruptive behaviour
templates.defaultAction: avoid behaviours that disrupt the learning of others and follow staff instructions
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action}. Progress will be monitored through {evidence} and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to meet with the learner to set expectations and agree support.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Record incidents and whether behaviour has improved.

templates.title: Respond to college communications
templates.defaultAction: check and respond to college messages within one college day
measureOptions: check college email every college day
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action}. This will be checked using {evidence} and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to confirm communication preferences and support the learner to check messages.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Record whether the learner is responding to messages.

templates.title: Increase classroom contributions
templates.defaultAction: attempt to contribute at least once per lesson
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action}. Progress will be reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to provide encouragement and set small achievable tasks to build confidence.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Record examples of contributions and next steps.

templates.title: Attend English or maths sessions
templates.defaultAction: attend the scheduled English or maths sessions
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action}. This will be checked using {evidence} and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to discuss barriers and provide catch-up support.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Record attendance and engagement in English and maths sessions.

templates.title: Complete Springpod activity
templates.defaultAction: complete the outstanding Springpod activities and upload or record the required evidence
templates.targetTemplate: By {reviewDate}, you will {action}. Progress will be checked using the work experience tracker and reviewed with {reviewer}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to provide guidance on completing Springpod activities and confirm evidence.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Confirm completion of required activities and record any barriers.

templates.title: Reduce risk to predicted achievement
templates.defaultAction: complete the recommended independent study and attend support sessions
templates.defaultMeasure: attend agreed support and complete independent study tasks
templates.targetTemplate: For the next {duration}, you will {action}. Progress will be checked using {evidence} and reviewed with {reviewer} on {reviewDate}.
templates.supportActionTemplate: {reviewer} to arrange targeted support and agree an action plan.
templates.reviewNoteTemplate: Record progress toward predicted achievement and next steps.
